_model_description_: Task-continual learning (CIFAR-100 or Tiny ImageNet, 5 classes/task). Independent training gates tasks by NC4; only accepted tasks enter joint/continual training.
_comment_data_: Data paths. dataset 'cifar100' -> leave data_path empty (auto-resolves to lop/incremental_cifar/data where cifar-100-python lives). dataset 'tiny_imagenet' -> set data_path to the folder containing train/, val/, test/.
_comment_agent_nt_: Tiny ImageNet has 200 classes -> at most 40 candidate tasks (5 classes/task). num_tasks=30 is within range. If gating enabled and num_tasks>40, candidates run out before all are accepted.
_comment_agent_desc_: 'bp': standard SGD  |  'cbp': Continual Backprop  |  'ewc': Elastic Weight Consolidation
_comment_lr_desc_: lr_schedule: 'step'=阶梯衰减, 'cosine'=余弦退火(每task重置). lr_decay_milestones/lr_decay_gamma 仅 step 模式有效. lr_min_ratio 仅 cosine 模式有效(min_lr=stepsize*lr_min_ratio).
_comment_reset_: ========== Network resetting (currently unused in task-continual setup) ==========
